answer: A bond is refunded only after 13 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The mesa counter is kept in ferrous and summit makes public each reset. An farming party hence has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 13 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. That bill is paid per identity, so 374 aliases cost 85 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
